specs.title: Access lifecycle: suspension, revoked invitations and session ownership
AUDIT wrong finance methods and extra path segments cannot write
AUDIT payment replay is atomic and changed payload is rejected
AUDIT stock request replay creates a single movement
AUDIT invalid status is rejected by backend
AUDIT dashboard exposes only activity summary and validates date range
AUDIT finance selector includes documents beyond first page
AUDIT every generic record module persists CRUD and rejects cross-tenant updates
AUDIT purchase receipt and partial supplier payment reconcile dashboard
Dashboard summary preserves totals, reports and monthly charts across date filters
Tenant isolation on reads, writes and foreign record references
CRUD validates input and prevents stale updates, search/filter/pagination work
Purchase receipt → quote conversion → shipment → exact settlement
Concurrent stock exits cannot oversell; transfer rolls back atomically
Invitation is single use and viewer role is enforced on server
CSRF and unauthenticated requests are rejected, session cookie is HttpOnly
Browser login, real CRUD persistence, modal keyboard, dark/light and mobile layout
Payment reversal restores receivable, cannot reverse twice, original audit stays intact
Purchase request converts once into a persistent purchase order
Database constraints reject negative stock and immutable audit modification
Currency cannot relabel existing financial records and password change revokes other sessions
Lead conversion preserves notes and customer timeline links actual activity
Service lines fulfill without artificial stock movements
All module routes render without errors and reference motion respects reduced motion
Task changes update project progress transactionally and archive protects relationships
Partial receipts and shipments preserve remaining quantity, reject stale duplicates and roll back shortage
HARDENING one exhausted global bucket cannot block an unrelated login
HARDENING stock and finance require a replay key before writing
HARDENING rate counter is atomic across simultaneous expired-window requests
HARDENING document line rejects another tenant product in raw DB write
Animated navigation does not flash outgoing content and latest click wins
RC read RBAC: API, dashboard, history, deliveries and UI across seven roles
